args.title: Update README.md to use the correct npm script for local development
args.body:
File: README.md

The "Running locally" section instructs users to run `npm run serve`, but this script does not exist. Based on the context, the correct script to use is `npm run dev` (or another appropriate script if it exists elsewhere in the project). Replace `npm run serve` with the correct script name to match the actual available commands in the project.
